text: The workflow I tested used a 5% canary and waited 30 minutes. We made the promote decision manually in the release call.
README says 10% and auto-promote after 15 minutes. Which config was actually deployed?
Please don't resolve this from memory. We need the synthetic deployment record or workflow run attached.
Rollback is a manual helm rollback in the runbook. I have not seen the auto rollback alert wired to the release workflow.
Who approves production promotion? I can find the deployment job but not an approval record.
Mark approval evidence missing and ask the release owner to provide it before publish.
